text: Siblings Louise and Michael [return to the family farm in Texas|trigger|going back home] as their father's long illness nears its end, and find their mother desperate for them to leave. That night she cuts off her own fingers and hangs herself in the barn. Her diary speaks of [a possibly demonic presence|threat|the devil and dark gods] preying on [their dying father|who_suffers|the old, sick and dying], and soon the goat herd lies slaughtered and [their dead mother appears in the barn|rules|it wears a familiar face].
